description: Look up geolocation, ISP and network info for any IPv4/IPv6 address or hostname, or an array of them for batch lookup. Returns ip, city, region, country, coordinates, ASN/ISP, timezone and continent (full name, e.g. North America); when a domain is queried, an extra `domain` field echoes it. Data source: DB-IP Lite (CC BY 4.0). Anycast IPs are approximate.

ip.description: IPv4/IPv6 address or hostname, e.g. 8.8.8.8 or example.com. Pass an array for batch lookup, e.g. ["8.8.8.8", "1.1.1.1"].

name: ip_lookup
title: IP / domain geolocation lookup
